title: 2026 Boston Marathon Official Course Map (PDF)
claims: The course starts on Main Street in Hopkinton and follows Route 135 through Ashland, Framingham, Natick and Wellesley.
At the junction of Routes 135 and 16 the course continues on Route 16 through Newton Lower Falls, then turns right at the fire station onto Commonwealth Avenue (Route 30).

The route follows Commonwealth Avenue through the Newton Hills, bears right at the reservoir onto Chestnut Hill Avenue to Cleveland Circle, turns left onto Beacon Street through Brookline and Kenmore Square, passes under Massachusetts Avenue, turns right onto Hereford Street against normal traffic flow, and turns left onto Boylston Street.
The finish is near the Boston Public Library in Copley Square.
The map labels the course 26.2 M / 42.2 K.
The elevation-profile axes are labelled in feet on the left and metres on the right.
The elevation profile places the start at the high end and the finish at the low end.
The map marks mile points 1 through 26 and the town boundaries.
The map states that Gatorade Endurance Formula and Poland Spring water are available to runners at every mile mark along the course and at the finish line.
The map carries a 2026 copyright notice stating that no portion of the map may be reproduced without permission of the Boston Athletic Association.

claimVerification.note: 图上方说明原文：起点在 Hopkinton Main Street，沿 Route 135 经 Ashland、Framingham、Natick、Wellesley。
原文写明 Route 135 与 16 交汇后走 Route 16 穿 Newton Lower Falls，在消防站右转上 Commonwealth Avenue（Route 30）。
原文按序写 Commonwealth Ave、Newton Hills、水库旁右转 Chestnut Hill Ave 至 Cleveland Circle、左转 Beacon St 穿 Brookline/Kenmore、Mass Ave 下方、右转 Hereford（逆向）、左转 Boylston。
原文：“finishing near the Boston Public Library in Copley Square”。
终点图标旁标注“F 26.2 M / 42.2 K”。
剖面左轴标题“ELEVATION FEET”，右轴“ELEVATION METERS”。
剖面起点位于高值端（约 450 ft），终点位于 0 m 端。
图面沿路线连续标出 1–26 英里数字，并在 Wellesley、Newton 等镇界标注地名。
黄色说明条原文：“Gatorade Endurance Formula and Poland Spring water are available to runners at every mile mark along the course and at the finish line.”
底部版权原文：“©2026. All rights reserved. No portion of this map may be reproduced without permission of the Boston Athletic Association.”

verification.checkedVia: curl.exe 下载 PDF + PyMuPDF 分区渲染为图像后用视觉读取
verification.note: PDF 无文字层，按区块渲染成图片逐段读取图面文字、图例、剖面轴与版权行。
